motion.name: card-hover
motion.purpose: Project card lift and media zoom on hover.

motion.name: swatch-select
motion.value: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) 500ms, scale(0.7) rotate(-4deg) to none, delayed to settle after the dossier cascade
motion.purpose: The one selected/lead skill chip on Profile snaps into place after its neighbors settle — the site's one authored signature moment, not a repeated hover gimmick.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Action CTA — Ember fill, restrained height.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border: none; border-radius: 0.525rem; background: #EA580C; color: #fff; font-family: Lexend, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, #EA580C 90%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.646 0.222 41.116) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet secondary action with accent wash on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border: none; border-radius: 0.525rem; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.141 0.005 285.823); font-family: Lexend, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: oklch(0.967 0.001 286.375); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.646 0.222 41.116) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Default Input
components.description: Transparent field with hairline border and ember focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid oklch(0.92 0.004 286.32); border-radius: 0.525rem; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.141 0.005 285.823); font-family: Lexend, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.552 0.016 285.938); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: oklch(0.646 0.222 41.116); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.646 0.222 41.116) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Contact Underline Field
components.description: Signature contact form field — bottom border only, ember focus.
components.css: .ds-input-underline { width: 100%; padding: 0.75rem 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.92 0.004 286.32) 80%, transparent); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.141 0.005 285.823); font-family: Lexend, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-input-underline::placeholder { color: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.552 0.016 285.938) 70%, transparent); } .ds-input-underline:focus { border-bottom-color: #EA580C; }

components.name: Default Badge
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 0.125rem 0.5rem; border-radius: 0.525rem; border: 1px solid transparent; background: oklch(0.646 0.222 41.116); color: oklch(0.98 0.016 73.684); font-family: Lexend, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Selected Swatch Chip
components.description: The Profile skill-chip signature: exactly one chip per group renders solid-filled as the 'selected' swatch; every sibling stays a neutral outline chip.
components.css: .ds-chip-selected { display: inline-flex; border-radius: 0.525rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; font-family: Lexend, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; background: #EA580C; color: #fff; } .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; border-radius: 0.525rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; font-family: Lexend, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; background: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.967 0.001 286.375) 60%, transparent); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.92 0.004 286.32) 70%, transparent); color: oklch(0.141 0.005 285.823); }

components.name: Project Card
components.description: Evidence tile with media, category chip, and hover lift.
components.css: .ds-card-project { display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.92 0.004 286.32) 60%, transparent); border-radius: 0.65rem; background: oklch(1 0 0); font-family: Lexend, sans-serif; transition: transform 0.3s ease; } .ds-card-project:hover { transform: translateY(-0.25rem); } .ds-card-project__media { aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; background: oklch(0.967 0.001 286.375); } .ds-card-project__body { padding: 1rem; } .ds-card-project__title { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(0.141 0.005 285.823); } .ds-card-project__meta { margin: 0.25rem 0 0; font-size: 0.75rem; color: oklch(0.552 0.016 285.938); }

components.name: Experience Rail Item
components.description: Timeline row: ember dot + connecting line, most-distinctive bullet always visible, remaining bullets behind a native disclosure.
components.css: .ds-rail-dot { display: inline-block; width: 0.75rem; height: 0.75rem; border-radius: 9999px; border: 2px solid #EA580C; background: oklch(1 0 0); }

components.css: .ds-header { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 40; width: 100%; border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.92 0.004 286.32) 40%, transparent); background: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(1 0 0) 80%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); font-family: Lexend, sans-serif; } .ds-header__inner { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; max-width: 72rem; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; } .ds-header__brand { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(0.141 0.005 285.823); } .ds-header__nav { display: flex; gap: 1rem; } .ds-header__nav a { font-size: 0.875rem; color: oklch(0.552 0.016 285.938); text-decoration: none; border-radius: 0.525rem; padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem; } .ds-header__nav a:hover { color: #EA580C; } .ds-header__nav a.is-active { background: #EA580C; color: #fff; }

narrative.overview:
This site is a recruiter-facing brief, not a mood board. Hierarchy is crisp and short: who you are, where you worked, what you shipped, how to reach you. Surfaces stay quiet so live demos and project evidence do the proving. Ornament is scarce; motion is purposeful (staggered dossier entrance, a swatch-select settle on the lead skill, soft card hover) rather than decorative noise.

The system is a light/dark shadcn-derived token set with Lexend as the single voice. Ember Orange marks actions, focus, and a small set of 'selected' states — never large fields of color. Density is comfortable: max-width 6xl (72rem) containers, generous section padding, and clear scan landmarks.
keyCharacteristics: Single typeface (Lexend) across display through label
Flat tonal layering with glass header; no structural shadow vocabulary
Committed Ember accent on CTAs, focus rings, active nav, and one 'selected' mark per group — bold where it appears, still scarce in coverage
Evidence-first project cards with soft hover lift only
Restrained controls: soft radius (~10.4px base), quiet borders

rules.name: The Calibrated Signal Rule
rules.body: Ember is the site's one committed color, but it still spends itself deliberately: full-saturation fills are reserved for the primary CTA, the active nav pill, and exactly one 'selected' mark per group (lead skill chip, active filter tab, current timeline dot) — never a large background wash.

rules.name: The Dual-Theme Parity Rule
rules.body: Light and dark share the same roles; dark steps the accent one notch brighter (orange-600 to orange-500) to hold contrast on near-black. Dark-mode utility variants resolve via a class-based @custom-variant bound to the .dark ancestor the theme toggle sets, not prefers-color-scheme.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Lexend is the only loaded face. Do not introduce a second display or serif pairing without an explicit redesign.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces rest flat. Do not add card drop shadows as a default treatment.

dos: Do keep the recruiter scan path short: profile → experience → projects → contact.
Do spend full-saturation Ember on the primary CTA and exactly one 'selected' mark per group.
Do use Lexend exclusively and size for hierarchy.
Do prefer tonal layering and blur over shadow stacks.
Do let project demos, thumbnails, and the profile portrait carry visual weight as real authored assets.
donts: Don't flood sections with primary Ember backgrounds.
Don't mark more than one chip/tab/dot per group as 'selected'.
Don't introduce a second display font or decorative serif without redesign intent.
Don't default cards to heavy drop shadows.
Don't invent testimonials, metrics, or employers not already on the site.
Don't turn the first viewport into a dashboard of stats — keep the brief clean.
